mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of each direct corporate shareholder, together with certificate of current officers and directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry in shareholder's place of incorporation (for example the Delaware Secretary of State or the Supreme Court Registry Office for Korean entities)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If the issuing jurisdiction is a party to the 1961 Hague Convention: notarization where required, then a single Apostille certificate from that jurisdiction's designated competent authority. If the issuing jurisdiction is not a Convention party: notarization, then authentication by the local Ministry of Foreign Affairs or equivalent, then consular legalization by the Embassy or Consulate General of the Republic of Korea. The Apostille route and consular route are parallel and mutually exclusive; they must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Corporate Existence for the parent shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporations registry, Secretary of State, or commercial court of the parent shareholder's domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: issue certificate, have the original signed or notarized as required, and affix Apostille by the designated competent authority. Non-Convention route: issue certificate, authenticate at the origin country's foreign affairs ministry, then legalize at the Korean consular post. Do not perform an Apostille and then consular legalization on the same document.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing the formation of the Korean Yuhan Hoesa and opening of bank or VASP accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the parent shareholder, signed by directors and countersigned by the corporate secretary; notarized by a public notary in the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The notary public must first legalize signatures; thereafter, if the origin country is an Apostille Contracting State, attach the Apostille. If not, proceed exclusively through consular legalization at a Korean diplomatic mission after completing origin-country authentication. These are alternative routing paths and must not be combined.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association of the parent shareholder and the draft Korean Articles of Association for the new Yuhan Hoesa
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Shareholder's corporate secretary and notary public in origin jurisdiction; for the Korean entity, a licensed Korean notary and the filing representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Foreign parent articles: notarize the certified copy, then either Apostille or Korean consular legalization depending exclusively on whether the origin state is an Apostille Convention member. The Korean draft Articles are a domestic instrument; notarization in Korea is sufficient, and no apostille or consular legalization is required for Korean domestic use.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter or Account Relationship Letter issued by the parent shareholder's principal bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank maintaining the parent shareholder's account; letterhead, banker's signature and official seal
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank letter must be an original on bank letterhead. If the bank is located in an Apostille Convention country, the bank signature is notarized and an Apostille is attached. If located in a non-Apostille country, the notarized bank signature is authenticated by the local competent authority and then legalized by the Korean consulate. No mixed Apostille-plus-consular treatment is accepted.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before onboarding any shareholder, director, or authorized signatory, counsel must screen the legal entity and all ultimate beneficial owners against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists, Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs autonomous sanctions list, FSC/KoFIU blacklists, FATF public statements and high-risk jurisdiction lists, and domestic and foreign politically exposed person databases at a 25% ownership threshold. Any PEP flag requires senior management approval, enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds evidence, and continuous transaction monitoring. A negative news and full-text red-flag check and sanctions risk assessment must be documented before any Stripe or USDC payment rail is enabled.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: iROS (Internet Registry Office of the Supreme Court of Korea) - Commercial Registration System for the Republic of Korea
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate name must be recorded in the Korean commercial register in Korean Hangul; the English or Romanized trade name may be filed as an auxiliary name if it is a phonetic translation of or clear equivalent to the Korean name. The four-tier naming convention requires (1) a distinctive proprietary word, (2) a business-objectives descriptor corresponding to ISIC 6201, (3) the legal-form suffix 'Yuhan Hoesa' or 'Limited Liability Company' in English usage, and (4) an optional geographic element. The registry search compares identical Hangul names and confusingly similar Romanized transliterations to protect prior licensees.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must request written reasons from the court registration officer within seven business days. If rejection is for identical or confusingly similar name, the company must revise the distinctive element and file a fresh name-clearance search. If the court persists in refusing despite a distinctive revision, the applicant may file an immediate judicial objection with the competent district court under the Non-Contentious Case Litigation Procedure Act within 14 days. The court will examine existing registrations, trademark registrations, and prior trade-name use; legal counsel should submit a written brief, evidence of advertisement and domain use, and request an oral hearing. This decision is a judicial registration decision rather than an administrative disposition, so the Administrative Appeal Act is not applicable.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office or commercial mailbox is not acceptable for this KR_YUHANGHOESA entity in the data-pipeline API and USDC payment sector. Korean tax authorities and regulated banks will require a fixed place of business in Korea where core management functions are actually carried out: a genuine office lease, one or more full-time responsible employees, operational equipment or cloud infrastructure management activities, Korean books and records, and a physical signboard. A serviced office with a dedicated desk, reception, and signed service agreement may be accepted by the tax authority if substance documentation is complete, but a registered-agent-only or PO-box address will be rejected for VAT and business registration and by financial institutions for enhanced due diligence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Inspection checklist: (a) company signboard; (b) office lease and rent payments; (c) employment contracts and four major social insurance filings; (d) servers or cloud infrastructure access logs; (e) accounting books and VAT invoices; (f) AML/CFT compliance manual and data-processing logs. Quantified risk: with a conventional lease and local employees the probability of an unannounced municipal tax or registry inspection in the first 12 months is 5-10%; with a serviced office and no dedicated staff, 25-35%; with a virtual or mailbox-only address, above 60%, including a realistic risk of denial of VAT registration and bank account closure.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea (Act No. 1000, as amended), particularly Articles 287-2 through 287-74 (Establishment of Limited Liability Companies), Articles 289 (Articles of Incorporation), Article 292 (Certification of Incorporation), Article 316 (Registration of Incorporation), and Article 635 (Application for Registration); Foreign Investment Promotion Act (Act No. 1559, as amended), Articles 4-6 and Enforcement Decree Articles 5-7; Framework Act on Administrative Investigations (Act No. 16144), Article 19.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registration Division, Seoul Central District Court, as well as the local branch office of the Korean Commercial Registration System; with respect to foreign direct investment reporting, the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency (KOTRA) One-Pass Center or the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE) window.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation Application (법인설립등기신청서) under the Commercial Act, accompanied by the authenticated Articles of Incorporation and the Initial Capital Contribution Report, together with the Foreign Investor Registration Report (외국인투자신고서) when a non-resident holds equity.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital for a Yuhan Hoesa (LLC) under the Commercial Act; however, at least one share must be issued and the total amount of capital subscribed must be fully paid-in, in cash, before the date of incorporation. The capital must be transferred into a designated escrow account opened in the company's name with a licensed Korean financial institution, and the balance certificate (잔액증명서) issued by the bank must be presented to the registering court. Capital in kind, if used, must be appraised by a court-appointed examiner and physically contributed prior to registration. Non-resident shareholders may contribute foreign currency, but must repatriate funds through a Korean exchange bank and must comply with the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act reporting.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF YUHANG HOESA, a limited liability company incorporated under the Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea. At a meeting of the board of directors duly convened and held [DATE] at the registered office address of the company, at which a quorum was present and acting throughout [or, where permitted under Article 287-52 of the Commercial Act and the Articles of Incorporation, an unanimous written consent of all members was obtained], the following resolutions were duly passed and adopted by the requisite majority. RESOLVED, that the total authorized capital of the company, as set forth in the Articles of Incorporation, in the amount of [KOREAN WON AMOUNT] divided into [NUMBER] shares, is hereby deemed validly subscribed and issued; that the actions of the incorporators in paying in the full subscription price by deposit into the corporate escrow account maintained at [BANK NAME AND ACCOUNT NUMBER] are ratified; that [BANK NAME] be and hereby is appointed as the principal banking institution of the company, and that the representatives jointly and severally be authorized to open, operate, close, and manage all corporate accounts, to sign all banking mandates, to issue and endorse checks, to execute electronic banking agreements, and to obtain currency exchange and foreign trade settlement facilities; RESOLVED, that the registered office of the company shall be located at [ADDRESS OF THE REGISTERED OFFICE IN THE REPUBLIC OF KOREA], and that legal process, service of process, and all statutory notices may be served at such address; RESOLVED, that [NAME] be and hereby is appointed as the Chief Executive Officer, that [NAME] be and hereby is appointed as the Chief Financial Officer, and that [NAME] be and hereby is appointed as the Company Secretary, each to hold office in accordance with the Articles of Incorporation; RESOLVED, that the company seal (법인인감) be adopted as the corporate seal, that the representative director shall have custody thereof, that the corporate registration certificate (사업자등록증) shall be preserved by the CFO, and that all documents issued by the company shall be signed by the representative director and countersigned by the company secretary; RESOLVED, that the officers be and hereby are authorized jointly and severally to execute and deliver any documents, tax registrations, industrial licensing applications, data-processing agreements, trade secret policies, and bank forms necessary to commence the company's business of commercial web scraping API and data pipeline services; RESOLVED, that the registered office under Article 48 of the Commercial Act is established, that notices respecting the public announcement of the balance sheet shall be published as required by Article 537-2, and that the officers shall open whatever securities, withholding, or value-added tax registrations are necessary; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the complete minutes of this meeting, including the capital contribution schedule, the bank authorization, the office adoption, and the officer appointments, be recorded in the corporate minute book, that the company secretary do sign the same as true, complete, and correct, and that all actions taken pursuant to this resolution are hereby approved, ratified, confirmed, and adopted as the acts of the company, and that certified copies of these resolutions be provided to all counterparties, regulators, and financial institutions. The resolutions above were adopted unanimously [or by the required majority] and constitute the full and lawful authority for the consummation of the transactions described therein.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve Corporate Name and Prepare Authenticated Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Supreme Court e-Registration System (I-reg / 인터넷등기소) and an authorized Notary Public within the jurisdiction of the Seoul Central District Court
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator must search the Korean commercial registry online database to confirm that the proposed Korean name of Yuhan Hoesa is not identical or deceptively similar to any existing registered company name. The name may be reserved for three months through a preliminary registration on the I-reg portal, using the applicant's digital certificate (공동인증서) or the personal identification method of a foreign passport. Simultaneously, the incorporator must prepare the Articles of Incorporation in the Korean language and have the same notarized by a Korean notary public, obtaining the certificate of authentication confirming that the founders signed before the notary. The Articles must include the corporate objective, the exact name of the company, the address of the registered office in the Republic of Korea, the total amount of capital, the par value per share, the total number of shares, the manner of publication, and the identity of the appointed representative. Foreign shareholders must sign either in person before the notary or execute a notarized power of attorney recognized by apostille under the Hague Convention; failure to obtain authentication will invalidate the application. Any deviation from the statutory content must be cured by a revised notarization. The notary will issue a certificate along with a duplicate certified copy of the articles; the incorporator must retain at least three certified duplicates for subsequent registrations.
required_dossiers: Reserved corporate name confirmation number (상호예약확인증)
Draft Articles of Incorporation in Korean
Notarized certificate of authentication of the Articles of Incorporation
Valid passports and resident identification of all founding members/investors
Certificate of personal seal impression (인감증명) or notarized signature for each director and auditor
Power of attorney with apostille for any remote incorporator or statutory agent
Foreign investor identification and nationality proofs if a non-resident member subscribes shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries the name reservation or the notary rejects the articles for deficiency, the incorporator must file a corrected or renamed application through the I-reg system. A formal objection or correction order may be appealed to the Registration Examination Officer within 14 days under the Registration of Non-Contentious Matters Rules; counsel may submit written arguments and a supplementary notarized statement of the Articles.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open Escrow Capital Contribution Account and Deposit Paid-in Capital with an Exchange Bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Korean commercial bank (any banking institution recognized under the Banking Act), with a branch exchange desk for Foreign Exchange Transactions Act reporting
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator must open an escrow account in the name of the future company with a licensed bank, clearly marking the account as a capital subscription escrow account. Each subscriber must transfer the agreed subscription amount in full, either in Korean won or convertible foreign currency, using a lawful payment method. The bank will issue a balance certificate (잔액증명서) stating the exact amount deposited and the names of the subscribers. For non-resident investors, the remittance must be routed through a Korean exchange bank and reported to the Bank of Korea under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act; an alien registration or passport copy must accompany the remittance. Once the capital is deposited, the funds cannot be withdrawn except for the payment of incorporation expenses or transferred to the company's working account after registration. The bank must confirm no suspicious-transaction reports arise from the deposit; if the AML/KYC review is delayed, the incorporation may be suspended. The escrow bank receipt must be included in the registration application package. The entire contribution, including any premium, must remain blocked until the court issues the certificate of registration, except that funds may be released to pay statutory incorporation costs upon a court instruction.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Founding members' identification documents and alien registration card or passport
Detailed capital contribution schedule (주식인수청약서) signed by each subscriber
Foreign currency purchase/sale confirmation or wire transfer receipt
Escrow account application form for capital subscription
Bank internal KYC forms and source-of-funds declaration
Power of attorney for person physically opening the account
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank halts the transaction due to AML or source-of-funds suspicion, the incorporators must submit a written source-of-funds explanation and corroborating contracts, invoices, or financial statements within 10 business days. Where the bank refuses issuance of the balance certificate for discrepancies, the incorporators may apply to another licensed bank or obtain a court-approved substitution procedure; any delay in deposit must be cured by a new balance certificate and amended subscription report before registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the Incorporation Registration Application with the Registration Court
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Civil Registration Division of the Seoul Central District Court (or the district court having geographic jurisdiction over the registered office location), via the I-reg online filing portal or in-person counter
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The representative director or an authorized statutory agent must file the application for company incorporation registration (법인설립등기신청) with the competent court no later than two weeks after the opening of incorporation, under Article 316 of the Commercial Act. The application form must contain the company name, the registered office address, the purpose, the issued shares, the identity of directors and auditors, and the representative potentate. The registration is subject to examination of the notarized Articles, the bank balance certificate, the capital receipt statements, the consent of auditors, and proof that taxes such as the local securities transaction tax or registration duty have been paid. The applicant must also submit the signature specimen card (서명감) and the corporate seal imprint certificate (인감카드) for the representative director, together with the certificate of personal seal impression of each statutory officer. Payment of court registration fees and local education surcharges must be completed before submission; the court computes fees based on the paid-in capital. Upon satisfaction of the examiner, the registry will assign the corporate registration number and issue the certificate of incorporation. Attorneys must verify that the registered purpose clauses exactly describe the production of web scraping API, data processing, and merchant gateway services so that post-registration tax registration is not impeded.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation Registration Application (법인설립등기신청서)
Notarized Articles of Incorporation (certified duplicate)
Bank balance certificate (잔액증명서) for escrow capital amount
Capital contribution ledger or subscription report (주금납입보관증명서)
Seal imprint card and signature specimen of the representative director
Certificate of personal seal impression of the representative director and each new director/auditor
Consent forms of appointed directors and statutory auditor
Power of attorney for legal counsel if using an agent
Proof of payment of registration duty and court fees
Foreign investor report receipt (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the court issues a supplementary instruction (보정명령) because of missing documents or an invalid objective clause, the applicant must cure the defect within two weeks by filing the required corrected document through the I-reg portal or by physical resubmission. If the application is rejected, a written administrative appeal may be made within 14 days to the court's registration examiner; legal representation is recommended to submit a memorandum against the rejection. A rejected application may be refiled after payment of a new registration fee if the statutory defects are eliminated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Business Registration Certificate and Apply for the Initial Corporate Tax and Withholding Accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local National Tax Service District Office (관할세무서), and the Local Taxation Division of the Municipal Government (e.g., Jongno-gu Office, Seoul)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after incorporation, the representative director must submit a business registration application (사업자등록신청서) to the district tax office that has jurisdiction over the registered office. The application must list the real business location, the taxpayer representative, the business activities, and the expected turnover; the application may be submitted via the Home Tax Service (홈택스) portal using the corporate digital certificate. The tax office will assign a ten-digit corporate registration number and issue a business certificate. Concurrently, the company must apply for electronic tax invoice certificates and electronic procurement card issuance under the Value-Added Tax Act. Under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, the company or a foreign investor must complete the post-incorporation foreign investment report to obtaining the KOTRA One-Pass certificate if the investment registration was not already completed. The company must also open a working corporate bank account, deposit the released capital, and notify the tax office of the bank account number within 15 days for the withholding tax registration. The municipality must be notified for the opening of the completion of the local tax file, and the corporate seal registration with the local registry is mandatory. Failure to register the business will result in assessment penalties; counsel should ensure that the address is a physical place where the tax authorities may conduct a field visit.
required_dossiers: Business registration application (사업자등록신청서)
Certificate of incorporation and corporate registration certificate
Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Certificate of corporate seal imprint (법인인감증명서)
Signature specimen of the representative director
Lease agreement or title deed for the registered office
Owner's consent for business registration if leased property
Corporate bank account balance certificate and working account opening proof
Proof of foreign investment filing (KOTRA One-Pass) if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office postpones the business registration for insufficient address documentation or an incomplete seal certificate, the applicant must supplement with an authenticated lease agreement, a building usage certificate, and an updated seal certificate. Requests for reconsideration may be made to the district office chief, and if not resolved within five days, a written appeal may be brought to the Director of the Regional Tax Office. Any ex officio registration without a business certificate must be rectified by a reapplication.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute PSC and Data-Licensing Ancillary Filings (Foreign Investment Report, Personal Information Protection Filings, and Custom API Terms Registration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency (KOTRA One-Pass), Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC) online filing system, and the Ministry of Science and ICT for value-added network reporting if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The company must ensure that the foreign equity investment, if any non-resident owns shares, is reported under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act within two years after issuance; counsel will prepare the investor's report with the amount and purpose. The company's business is commercial web scraping and data pipeline, therefore the operator may need to register the main office as an online data service provider under the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization (if the API is materialized by a Korean data center). A privacy compliance officer and privacy policy must be prepared under the Personal Information Protection Act; if the scraping API processes Korean resident data, the company must file the privacy policy and retain consents. A domestic agent for foreign data controllers is required for service providers outside Korea; since the company will be established in Seoul, counsel must designate the establishment as the Korean agent and file the same with the PIPC. For payment rail integration, the cryptocurrency and Stripe services require compliance with anti-money laundering verification; the company must identify a compliance officer and file a suspicious transaction report procedure under the Financial Transaction Reports Act if virtual asset handling is present. Substantively, the filing dossiers include the KOTRA report form, personal information processing policy, privacy impact assessment if any large-scale scraping data sets are involved, and the terms of service for the API. Counsel should also register the corporate data processing agreement for third-party merchant pipelines and ensure that the API user-facing terms are published on the platform within 30 days after launch.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Promotion Act report form (외국인투자신고서) and receipt
Certificate of incorporation and passport of foreign investor
Personal information processing policy and consent forms, English/Korean
Designation of domestic agent for PIPC filing
Privacy impact assessment report if processing high-risk scraping data
Data processing agreement template for API clients
Cryptocurrency exchange/virtual asset service provider registration or exemption memo if USDC rails active
Payment gateway onboarding package for Stripe and a summary of the Merchant of Record agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the foreign investment report is rejected or amended, the applicant must resubmit within two weeks with a memorandum from counsel; failure to file incurs a fine and later securities registration may be blocked. If PIPC orders corrections to the privacy policy, the company has 14 days to correct; counsel will file an amended policy and response through the PIPC e-service. In the event of the Ministry of Science rejecting a VCN registration because of incomplete network documents, the company may cure via supplementary information or apply excluding such registration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - no physical industrial licensing board is required because the entity performs purely digital services under ISIC 6201 and NAICS 518210.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing operating permit applies to this commercial web scraping and proxy API gateway venture.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment of the Republic of Korea (환경부), Environmental Impact Assessment Bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - the entity is not engaged in physical construction, industrial processing, or a project listed under Articles 22 or 43 of the Environmental Impact Assessment Act; consequently no full EIA, provisionary EIA, or environmental registration is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - the entity has no industrial wastewater discharge, no VOC-emitting process, no fuel combustion plant, and no hazardous waste generation. The company must nevertheless comply with generic E-waste obligations under the Act on Resource Circulation of Electrical and Electronic Equipment if importing or selling computer-related hardware, with server room disposal rules, and with the Waste Management Act if any small quantities of office waste batteries or packaging are generated.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable - the operation is an office/data-services facility, not a high-rise chemical or manufacturing site. If the company subleases a single small office suite, it must obtain a basic fire suppression inspection certificate and a simple firefighting system operation checklist from the local National Fire Agency; and it must register the workplace with the Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency and appoint a workplace safety manager if the headcount reaches the applicable threshold. No heavy civil defense certification is required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) of the Republic of Korea; electronic portal is HomeTax (hometax.go.kr). Customs export clearance and cross-border documentation interface is Korea Customs Service UNI-PASS (unipass.customs.go.kr).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign non-resident entity operating as a Yuhan Hoesa with a Korean place of business, the domestic representative must submit an Application for Business Registration to the local district tax office having jurisdiction over the principal business address. The filing pack must include certificate of incorporation, articles of incorporation, appointment of a domestic business representative, power of attorney if a tax representative is appointed, proof of the Korean fiscal address, bank account details, and the representative's foreign-registration or alien certificate where applicable. Upon approval NTS issues the Business Registration Certificate and assigns the 10-digit Business Registration Number used as the taxpayer identification number for corporate tax and VAT. For a foreign entity with no Korean establishment that supplies electronic services, including web scraping, proxy API, or other digital services, to non-registered Korean customers, the entity must file simplified foreign VAT registration through HomeTax, appoint a statutory tax representative in Korea for service of process and VAT compliance, and obtain a VAT registration identification number before the first taxable supply. Registration is mandatory from first taxable activity; there is no turnover-based de minimis.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The Republic of Korea does not operate a check-the-box or entity classification election. A Yuhan Hoesa is a statutory juridical entity taxed at the entity level under the Corporate Income Tax Act. Group consolidation is available only under specific qualifying parent-subsidiary conditions and does not constitute an entity classification election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value-Added Tax Act of the Republic of Korea
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: KRW 0.00; mandatory upon commencement of taxable supplies or import of services in Korea. A non-resident supplier of electronic digital services to Korean customers is required to register from the first supply; simplified taxpayer turnover bands reduce invoicing and filing convenience but do not waive registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Korea operates a mandatory electronic tax invoice regime under the VAT Act. All VAT-registered suppliers issuing tax invoices for domestic supplies must transmit e-tax invoices to the National Tax Service through HomeTax or certified e-invoice intermediaries. The supplier must issue and transmit the e-tax invoice within the statutory deadline generally by the 10th day of the month following the supply date; the NTS performs electronic schema validation, documentary serial-number control, and automated matching between supplier output invoices and purchaser input invoices. This is not a real-time pre-clearance model but is a statutory near-real-time e-reporting and anti-fraud matching system with ERP-to-HomeTax API integration for high-volume filers. Paper invoices are permitted only in limited cases involving simplified taxpayers or technical failure contingencies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Article 21 of the VAT Act, exported goods are zero-rated when they are physically exported under a Korea Customs Service export clearance declaration. Qualifying exported services, including international services and certain offshore digital services, are zero-rated when supplied to a non-resident customer, supplied from Korea to overseas users, performed or consumed wholly outside Korea, and settled in foreign exchange with documented repatriation. For the ISIC 6201 web scraping and proxy API gateway business, the exported digital service qualifies for 0% VAT if the Korean supplier provides the API or data services to non-resident customers using the service outside Korea, invoices in foreign currency, and receives the consideration through an authorized foreign exchange bank or legitimate cross-border settlement rail. The supplier must retain the service contract, foreign-currency commercial invoice, usage logs or gateway records showing offshore consumption, and bank remittance evidence. Any digital service that is actually used or exploited in Korea remains standard-rated regardless of the residence of the contracting customer.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Korea Customs Service Export Declaration (Export Clearance Certificate) generated through UNI-PASS
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill or international consignment note
Inward Remittance Certificate / Foreign Exchange Earning Certificate issued by an authorized Korean foreign exchange bank confirming receipt of the export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The NTS and Korea Customs Service jointly audit export zero-rating by cross-matching UNI-PASS customs declarations, e-tax invoice output, input invoice data, bank foreign-exchange records, and VAT refund claims. If the exporter or service supplier cannot produce the required documentation bundle, or if export proceeds are not repatriated within 180 days, the zero-rate is disallowed retroactively. NTS will assess unpaid VAT at the standard 10% rate plus binding interest and additional penalties for insufficient returns, unreported returns, or false returns. Fraudulent export zero-rating claims may trigger penalty surcharges of up to 40% of underpaid VAT and criminal referral under the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act for intentional tax evasion.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of Korea (BOK), acting with the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MOEF) as the foreign exchange authority under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Korean won is convertible on the current account; trade-related and ordinary service payments are liberalized and may be remitted through foreign exchange banks with reporting obligations. Capital account transactions, including equity injections, loans, and acquisition of local assets, are generally permissible but require prior declaration, purpose-code reporting, and supporting underlying documentation. A foreign enterprise may convert USD or other foreign currency into KRW at prevailing market rates, but the won is not an internationally deliverable currency outside specified markets; offshore trading is concentrated in NDFs because KRW settlement is restricted outside licensed domestic banks. Profit and dividend remittance is permitted after local payment of corporate and withholding taxes; the paying bank requires audited financial statements, board resolution, tax payment certificate and, if applicable, a tax treaty residence certificate to reduce the statutory 22% withholding rate. The regime therefore offers current-account freedom but imposes compliance gates on capital repatriation rather than absolute bans. Treasury structuring should rely on a licensed Korean foreign-exchange bank for all conversions and avoid offshore KRW liquidity pools.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, export proceeds are collected through a Korean authorized foreign-exchange bank; for goods, the customary statutory settlement timeline is 90 days from export declaration unless an extension for deferred payment terms is approved, while services/API proceeds follow the invoiced due date. No mandatory surrender percentage exists; exporters may hold 100% of proceeds in a foreign currency account or convert into KRW freely. Each receipt must be filed by the bank in the Electronic Foreign Exchange Reporting System within 30 days.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Basic Operational Currency Account (KRW and USD settlement)
Capital Escrow Account / Basic Operational Currency Account (KRW and USD settlement)
Capital Escrow Account / Basic Operational Currency Account (KRW and USD settlement)
Capital Escrow Account / Basic Operational Currency Account (KRW and USD settlement)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Overseas fintech EMIs without a Korean license cannot hold KRW deposits or clear payments under the Electronic Financial Transactions Act. They may operate only as an interface over a licensed Korean bank account; direct handling of the entity's funds is legally unavailable. Stripe can aggregate foreign card receipts but must settle to a local bank account in KRW or USD via an acquiring bank partnership.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person onboarding is effectively mandatory for a Yuhan Hoesa with non-resident ownership. At least one statutory director or an appointed local authorized signatory must attend a branch interview with original corporate documents, passport, and a notarized power of attorney. Remote video KYC may accelerate pre-screening, but major tier-1 banks will not finalize account opening without branch-level identity verification or, in limited cases, a consular-apostilled POA allowing the bank's compliance officer to interview the director by video.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owner with a recent cryptocurrency and USDC wallet history and no Korean credit footprint.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified virtual asset service provider transaction history, wallet ownership proof via cryptographic signatures, source-of-funds letters from the transferor, personal tax returns, audited financial statements of the direct investor, and a sworn affidavit explaining each USDC conversion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registered business scope of web scraping and API resale may raise data privacy, IP infringement, or unlicensed payment aggregation concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed client contracts, data-source licensing agreements, terms-of-service compliance policy, ISO 27001 or ISMS-P certification, technical architecture diagrams showing direct settlement to the operational account, and a data deletion protocol.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Fragmented treasury flows from Stripe and USDC may disguise third-party settlement or an unlicensed money services activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Processor settlement statements, merchant-of-record agreements, monthly bank reconciliation, export purpose code declarations for each inbound SWIFT credit, and a signed undertaking that the entity handles only its own operating revenue and no third-party funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Zero or tokenistic registered capital relative to projected API subscription turnover can indicate shell structure or front-running.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital verification report, audited financial statements, future cash-flow model, corporate board minutes approving shareholder loans or equity injections, and proof of local registered office and operational staff.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The non-resident shareholder remits via SWIFT MT103 from an account bearing the investor name and reference, citing the purpose code for equity investment in a foreign-invested company. The Korean bank registers the foreign exchange receipt, performs source-of-funds screening, and the entity's external accountant issues a capital verification after the credited funds remain available. Foreign Investment Promotion Act reporting is completed through the bank within 30 days, and a dedicated capital escrow release letter may be required for registered capital before the commercial registry filing.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: SWIFT MT103 is used for recurring license, hosting, and subcontractor payments; irrevocable commercial letters of credit are recommended for high-value hardware or datacenter procurement; documentary collections (D/P and D/A) cover milestone-based software and data delivery. The bank assigns each outbound remittance a trade or non-trade purpose code, performs sanctions screening, and requires invoices and contracts to be retained for five years.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore USD/KRW outright forward contracts with underlying service-export exposure and a tenor normally capped at five years
KRW non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed only through licensed banks where physical KRW settlement is restricted and supported by trade documentation
Cross-currency swaps for long-term foreign currency liabilities, with Bank of Korea reporting for tenors exceeding one year
Plain-vanilla USD/KRW FX options and collar structures used to hedge budget rates on confirmed future export contracts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return and Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service (NTS), Republic of Korea
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year company, by March 31 of the following year; if audited financial statements are attached, the deadline is extended to April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Additional penalty of 20% of negligent under-declared tax or 40% of fraudulent under-declared tax, plus 0.022% daily late-payment interest; continued non-filing permits NTS asset seizure and, after 3 consecutive years of no filing, administrative closure of the business registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Local Income Tax Surtax Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: City or Provincial Local Tax Authority (WETAX system)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same as corporate income tax deadline: within 3 months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year company, by March 31 with one-month extension if corporate return is extended
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% to 20% of unpaid local income tax plus daily late-payment interest at 0.022%; coercive collection via bank attachment, real estate seizure, and revocation of business tax registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Approval and Regular General Meeting of Members
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company registered office; National Tax Service for the corporate tax filing copy; Court Registry Office for any ensuing director or registered-office change filings
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year company, by June 30 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold an approved regular meeting renders financial statements unauthorised; late registration of director changes triggers administrative fine up to KRW 5 million per event; a dormant company may be administratively struck off by the tax authority after repeated non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual External Audit Report (mandatory for qualifying companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service; Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) for companies subject to the external audit law; a copy must be retained at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audit must be completed and the report attached to the corporate income tax return no later than the extended filing deadline of April 30 for calendar-year companies; auditor appointment is made at the regular meeting held within 6 months after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to undergo a statutory audit or submit the audit report results in administrative penalty of up to 10% of the audit-default amount and criminal fine for directors up to KRW 30 million; tax authorities may refuse tax clearance and impose a deemed assessment

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Status Report (applicable if any non-resident ownership is present)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE) through KOTRA / Invest Korea
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end for the annual foreign-invested enterprise status report; any shareholding transfer or UBO change must be reported within 30 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to KRW 2 million for non-reporting and up to KRW 10 million for false reporting; repeated violations may strip the company of foreign-investment tax benefits and trigger enhanced AML scrutiny, but do not by themselves dissolve the entity

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the Republic of Korea's Act on External Audit of Stock Companies, mandatory certification by an independent CPA/auditing firm applies if any of the following is present at fiscal year-end: (a) total assets of KRW 12 billion or more (approximately USD 9.2 million); (b) total assets of KRW 7 billion or more and a full-time workforce of 100 or more employees; (c) the company is a listed issuer, financial institution, or designated by the Financial Services Commission; (d) the company is a securities-related financial company; or (e) the company voluntarily adopts an audit or is required to do so by its articles of association. Annual turnover alone does not create an audit obligation in Korea, except when combined with size criteria designated by the FSC for large unlisted private companies.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: K-IFRS (Korean International Financial Reporting Standards) for FSS-designated and larger public-interest entities; Korean GAAP or the Korean SMEs Accounting Standards for a private Yuhan Hoesa; tax accounting follows the Corporate Tax Act with additional adjustments in the tax return; all required financial statements must contain an auditor's report in Korean and be prepared using the accrual basis.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: South Korea does not operate a separate annual UBO filing accessible to all companies; instead, the Yuhan Hoesa must maintain a continuous member register, re-confirm it at each annual general meeting, and record every ownership transfer in the member register immediately. A transfer not recorded in the company register has no effect against the company or bona fide third parties. If the company qualifies as a foreign-invested entity, any change in foreign shareholding or ultimate beneficial ownership must be reported to MOTIE/KOTRA within 30 days of the transaction. Financial Institutions under the AML regime separately perform annual CDD/UBO verification, but that is not a corporate registry filing.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 - 1,200 per year for a registered office or corporate secretarial agent in Seoul or provincial jurisdictions
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - 25,000 per year depending on revenue, cross-border transactions, number of foreign shareholders, and accounting complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Free economic zone (FEZ) and foreign investment zone (FIZ) enterprises may enjoy 100% corporate income tax exemption for 3 years and 50% for the next 2 years; R&D and forward-looking data technology deductions are available under the Restriction of Special Taxation Act; no general patent box regime

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return (Form No. 6-1) submitted through the National Tax Service Home Tax Service (HTS) electronic filing portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after the end of the fiscal year (March 31 for calendar-year taxpayers); one-month extension allowed upon application with a provisional payment schedule

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total worldwide gross revenue from the web scraping and proxy API gateway operations, including subscription fees, usage-based API charges, and incidental integration services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Korean-domiciled Yuhan Hoesa is taxed on worldwide income. For non-resident-owned capital, the entire revenue must be declared without any offshore allocation unless an advance pricing agreement or valid transfer pricing documentation supports a foreign profit split.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back schedule for excessive management fees, technology royalties, commission sharing, and entertainment expenses paid to foreign affiliates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any royalty or service fee paid to an offshore parent or sister entity must be tested under the arm's length principle. If the beneficiary lacks functional and economic substance, the payment is disallowed as a deduction and is recategorized as a disguised dividend subject to 22% withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 (Taxable Income Computed Before Loss Carryforward)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjustable taxable income after all statutory addbacks and exclusions are applied, before net operating loss relief.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident-owned Korean LLC, thin capitalization rules disallow interest paid to foreign controlling shareholders where the debt-to-equity ratio exceeds 2:1. Any such excess interest must be reclassified as a constructive dividend.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current-year utilization of prior-year net operating losses from the Tax Loss Carryforward Schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only 5 years of carryforward are permitted for general corporations. Losses must be evidenced by audited books, and continuity of ownership is not a statutory requirement, but losses sustained before the influx of non-resident capital may be denied if the acquisition lacks a bona fide business purpose.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 (Tax Credits and Foreign Tax Relief)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credit, R&D tax credit, and investment tax credit calculations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Korean corporation owned by foreign shareholders may claim a foreign tax credit for taxes paid on foreign-source income. The credit is limited to Korean corporate tax attributable to that foreign income. Substantiation includes tax assessment documents translated into Korean with apostille certification.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 (Withholding Tax on Non-Resident Passive Income)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of corporate withholding tax obligations for Tokyo-based (or otherwise foreign) shareholders receiving dividends, interest, or royalties from the Korean entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Korean LLC must withhold 22% on outgoing dividends, interest, and royalties to non-resident beneficial owners, unless a double tax treaty reduction is claimed. Withholding is reported and paid using Form No. 23-1 (Withholding Tax on Non-Resident) on the due date prescribed by the Collection Rule.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file on time triggers a 20% negligence penalty on the unpaid tax (10% for general unintentional omission). Late payment interest accrues at 1.8% per month from the due date. In case of fraudulent underreporting exceeding KRW 300 million or 30% of total tax, criminal prosecution under the Punishment of Tax Evasion Act may lead to imprisonment up to 10 years and fines up to 5 times the evaded tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 22% (20% national withholding plus 2% local income tax surcharge)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim DTA relief, the Korean LLC must submit Form No. 23-1 (Application for Tax Abatement under Tax Treaty) to the National Tax Service before the withholding tax deadline. The beneficial owner must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the foreign tax authority and provide a beneficial ownership statement attesting that the recipient is not an intermediary and has practical power over the income. The TRC must be apostilled / consularized and translated into Korean. Since 2021, the Payable Free Zone (PFZ) procedure allows deferred withholding upon approval for passive income flows to EU and other treaty jurisdictions if the foreign shareholder holds at least 10% participation and meets a rule of substance-independence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT for cross-border royalty and interest is 22% (20% national + 2% local). The OECD-esque bilateral treaty framework generally reduces interest to 10% and royalties to 10%-15%, depending on the jurisdiction and the patent / technology nature of the IP. Reduced rates are conditional on the foreign recipient being the clear legal owner of the IP and performing management, licensing, and research functions unrelated to the Korean payor.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: KRW 100 billion annual revenue - earning companies with related-party cross-border transactions exceeding KRW 50 billion must prepare and submit Local File and Master File; Refresh documentation threshold for a standard small-cap Yuhan Hoesa is KRW 5 billion in intercompany transactions (same country relation) and KRW 10 billion for cross-border controlled transactions (if annual revenue is under KRW 100 billion, simplified / real-time audit documentation applies).
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Although Korea does not maintain a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime, the National Tax Basic Act Article 14 applies a substance-over-form doctrine. For a cross-border API gateway company, the Korean entity must prove that its management decisions, server operations, customer contracting, billing systems, and data-processing employees are located in Korea. If the entity is a shell with its actual income-generating activities in a no-tax jurisdiction, the NTS may recharacterize the arrangements and impose tax on the true passing-through of profits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally issuing forged invoices and underreporting API subscription revenues earned in the Republic of Korea, particularly when consumption is routed through offshore invoicing shells controlled by the same Korean shareholder.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 9 of the Punishment of Tax Evasion Act - imprisonment up to 10 years, plus a fine of up to 5 times the evaded tax amount; monetary penalty may not be less than the tax avoided if intentional tax evasion exceeds KRW 100 million.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A corporate veil will be pierced where the director ignored internal controls or used tax saving structures to enrich himself individually. Directors become jointly and severally liable for the unpaid corporate tax plus penalty accruals (National Tax Basic Act Article 39). The NTS may enjoin departure (travel ban), freeze personal bank accounts, and sale of personal assets. Imprisonment is available for the maximum statutory term; a criminal fine is also executed together with civil restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Thin Capitalization and Disguised Dividend Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Funding the Korean LLC through excessive loans from non-resident shareholders and charging inflated interest while no dividend withholding is paid; the debt-to-equity ratio exceeds 2:1, and the interest rate is inflated above the arm's length borrowing rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 54 of the Korean Tax Procedure Act (Thin Capitalization Rules) - interest recharacterized as a non-deductible distribution, corporate income tax recomputed, and 22% withholding tax imposed on the recharacterized interest; additional 20% penalty for unfiled withholding; administrative and criminal liability under the Punishment of Tax Evasion Act if deceit is involved.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who served as the signor of the loan agreement or who structured the funding arrangement is personally liable for the recharacterized dividend tax and any criminal fine. The NTS may issue an oarsman (travel ban) and impose a seizure over real estate, automobiles, and securities held by the director. If the director is convicted under Article 9 of the Punishment of Tax Evasion Act, imprisonment between 1 and 10 years applies, plus a fine of up to 5 times the intentionally evaded amount.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving USDC crypto payments from data scraping API clients and converting them to fiat through unlicensed cryptocurrency exchangers, without registering as a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) under the Financial Information Act and without declaring the crypto proceeds in the corporate income tax return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 17 of the Act on Reporting and Using Specific Financial Information (Korea Anti-Laundering Act) - imprisonment up to 5 years or a fine up to KRW 50 million for unlicensed VASP operation; income tax evasion penalty up to 40% of the unreported amount under the Framework Act on National Taxes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Because the director owns and directs the Korean Yuhan Hoesa, the NTS and Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) treat the entity as a transparent conduit for the non-reporting financial conduct. The director faces personal criminal liability for money laundering, punitive fines, and confiscation of the illicit gains. A corporate veil can be pierced under the Basic Act if the director used the entity as a shield to conceal his own crypto arbitrage; the director may be blacklisted by the Korean Financial Intelligence Unit (KoFIU) for cross-border remittance restrictions, and travel abroad is prohibited while under criminal investigation. Korean courts have upheld director imprisonment of up to 5 years and KRW 50 million fine for funneling crypto proceeds through shell companies without KYC/AML procedures.
